notes.title: Blood Oath Streaming Event!
notes.content:
Welcome!

Blood Oath is going to participate on the upcoming Steam Festival, and as such, we invite all of you to play with us on ArcadeMode! There will be a broadcast that will be shown on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1399190/Blood_Oath_When_The_Sword_Rises/]Steam Page[/url]

Join the fight and play versus devs on February 5th 21:00 and February 7th 18:00 GMT+1 (CET)

We will answer questions about the game and will play on ArcadeMode with other players.

See you there!
